verdict.rationale: Brave documents site-specific queries (`site:github.com rust tutorials`) for restricting results to a domain. Its Goggles feature lets developers boost or demote specific websites and domains and is described as 'custom reranking & result filtering', which covers the exclusion side. missing for 10: explicitly documented domain-exclusion syntax (e.g. -site: or a Goggles discard rule), a dedicated include/exclude-domains API parameter, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
